description: Defines structures, constants, and functions for parsing and handling X.509 distinguished names and their attributes, including OID constants, the X509NameAttribute struct, and functions for parsing and converting name data.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded attribute type and value in an X.509 distinguished name, with methods for converting to string formats.

methods.name: ValueAsString
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a UTF-8 string if possible.

methods.name: ValueAsStringWithUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a UTF-8 string with configurable handling options.

methods.name: ValueAsStringUnsafe
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a string without verifying encoding compatibility.

methods.name: AsRFC2253String
methods.description: Formats the attribute as an RFC2253-compliant ASCII string.
